args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1). Rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) describing the rollback.

Summary of what I did:
- **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all regions, unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the last healthy production release.
- **Rolled back**: v2.3.1 → v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west (status: rolled_out).
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 INC-0001 for checkout-api, paging on-call, with a summary of the failure and the rollback action.
